svg.title: Qualify capacity and throughput before interpreting speed
svg.desc: Synthetic arithmetic examples are separate from published GPU specifications
svg.text: Qualify capacity and throughput before interpreting speed
Synthetic arithmetic examples are separate from published GPU specifications
70 GiB visible budget − 32 weights − 8 non-KV − 4 margin = 26 GiB KV.
At 256 MiB/request: payload-only bound 104; the 105th needs another 256 MiB.
64 MiB / 1,935 GB/s ≈ 34.682 µs for an ideal device-memory read.
Cache-served reads and H2D/D2H links have different boundaries and denominators.
Arithmetic: dense, sparse and precision labels matter
312 dense / 624 structured-sparse FP16 Tensor TFLOP/s are qualified peaks.
Valid 2:4 data and backend support are required; silent pruning changes the matrix.
Validation: check values, completion and operating state
Include packing, metadata and workspace in their declared boundaries.
Ordered windows show association; they cannot prove a power-policy effect.
An inventory is not a benchmark. A benchmark is not production capacity or a stable tail guarantee.
